lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Reminder: Supply sub Halcyon completes cargo transfer at fourteen hundred hours. Please keep Docking Ring lanes clear.
lines.direction: smooth, overly polite automated TAG corporate PA

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Routine hydrostatic ballast cycle in Sector Three will begin in ten minutes. Minor hull vibration is normal.

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: TAG Industries reminds all personnel to stay hydrated. Recycled water stations are available in every wing.
lines.direction: warm corporate wellness reminder, faintly impersonal

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Galley notice: Hot lunch service begins at eleven thirty in the Commons. Today's menu features protein stew.

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Attention: East Corridor environmental maintenance remains underway. Please route laboratory deliveries through Admin.
lines.direction: smooth corporate euphemism, calm and unhurried

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Hydroponics advises that fresh greens from Grow Hall batch twelve will be available in the Commons this evening.

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Security reminder: Please wear your clearance badge visibly at all times. Unbadged personnel will be delayed at checkpoints.
lines.direction: firm yet polite automated security policy

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Dive Bay notice: All wet-deck equipment must be logged before launch trunk cycling. Thank you for your cooperation.

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: TAG Industries appreciates your service beneath the surface. Safety is our shared commitment.

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Automated notice. Sector Four biological containment seal remains active. Do not attempt manual override.

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Warning. Main electrical bus voltage below operational threshold. Non-essential life support is on reserve.

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Attention all personnel. Please remain at your assigned muster station until clearance is confirmed.
lines.direction: calm polite emergency protocol spoken into an empty station

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Automated alert. Ventilation filtration bypass detected in East Wing ducts. Maintenance has been notified.

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Notice. Surface communications uplink is currently unavailable. Messages will queue for next scheduled burst.

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Transit advisory. Primary rail traction power is offline. Emergency shuttle boarding is suspended.

lines.speaker: pa
lines.text: Automated status. External hull integrity nominal. Internal security lockdown remains in effect.
